newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED LOSE THIRD SUCCESSIVE LEAGUE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED LOSE THIRD SUCCESSIVE LEAGUE MATCH.

text.p: Manchester United's miserable autumn continued on Saturday when they lost 2-1 at home to Chelsea -- their third successive premier league defeat.

Michael Duberry put the Londoners ahead with a first-half header. Gianluca Vialli scored Chelsea's second after the break, latching on to a defence-splitting pass from Frank Le Boeuf and threading the ball between the legs of goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel.
David May raised United's hopes with a headed goal nine minutes from time but Chelsea held on and thoroughly deserved their win.
Chelsea, who have now lost only twice in their last 22 visits to Old Trafford, go fourth. United slip to sixth, six points behind leaders Arsenal who drew 2-2 at third-placed Wimbledon.
United's dismal form has yet to hit their gate receipts. A premier league record 55,198 watched Saturday's match.
